Game Overview

In Maze of Infection, the core idea is straightforward: escape the claustrophobic corridors of Maze of Infection as a janitor trapped in a zombie-infested building. Navigate the chilling maze with limited resources; every wrong turn is dangerous. Strategically use or evade the undead, ensuring each step edges you closer to a nerve-wracking exit. Can you survive the horror?
